literal_meaning: ঘাটের কড়ি (ঘাটের গোলা বা শঙ্খাকার মুদ্রা)
figurative_meaning_en: Unable to cross the ghat (fail to achieve the goal or complete the task)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পে আমরা ঘাটের কড়ি হয়ে গেলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: He couldn't cross the ghat in the job exam.
We ended up with ghat's cowries in this project, meaning it was worthless.
history: Originating from Bengal's river ferry systems where crossing ghats was essential for travel; cowries as obsolete currency symbolize futility.
note: The idiom evokes the imagery of useless cowries washed ashore, tying into the provided meaning of inability to succeed.
